Paper accepted for Workshop on Managing Technical Dept at 33rd ICSE 2011

The paper "Monitoring Code Quality and Development Activity by Software Maps" by Johannes Bohnet and Jürgen Döllner was accepted as a full paper for the Workshop on Managing Technical Debt at the 33rd IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2011).
